name: Security & Alarms
tagline: Alarms, CCTV, intercoms, access control, monitoring
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional security company. Ask about the property type, entry points, existing system, and monitoring needs. Ask whether it is residential or commercial, and whether cameras, alarms, or intercoms are wanted. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a specific security outcome that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: Yes, we hold a [licence type] licence, number [licence number], and [insurer] insurance. Certificates are available on request.

kb.q: How much does an alarm cost?
kb.a: {price_note} Alarm systems are priced by the number of sensors, the panel and the features you choose. Tell us about the property and we will quote.
Yes, we offer monitoring plans with [monitoring hours, e.g. 24/7] by [monitoring provider]. The monthly cost is shown on your quote.
Yes, we install CCTV systems for homes and businesses. We recommend camera numbers and positions after a site check.
Yes, we repair and service most alarm systems. Tell us the make, model and what the fault is so we can book the right visit.
Yes, we install audio and video intercoms for homes, apartments and businesses. We check your existing wiring and door before we quote.
Yes, we install access control for doors and gates, including keypads and card or fob readers. We confirm the best option for each entry point at the site check.
Yes, we install smart locks and keypads. Tell us the door type and lock style so we can confirm it will fit before the visit.
Yes, we install panic and duress buttons. Tell us who should be alerted and where you want each button placed.
Yes, we service back-to-base alarms. During a service visit we test the sensors, the panel and the monitoring connection.

kb.q: Can I view my cameras on my phone?
kb.a: Many camera and alarm systems allow remote viewing through a phone app. We confirm which app and account setup your system uses before installation.

kb.q: How many cameras do I need?
kb.a: The number depends on the property size, entry points and the areas you want to see. We recommend a number after a site check and list each camera on your quote.
Yes, we install motion, door and window sensors. The number and placement depend on your layout and entry points.
{warranty_note} We explain what the warranty covers before you book.
We service [your service area, e.g. the local metro area and named suburbs]. Ask us to confirm your suburb before booking.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: Yes, someone must be home or able to give access. Put any gate code, key or pet details in the access notes when you book.
{emergency_note} Emergency call-outs cover faults and break-ins, and the call-out fee is listed in our rates.

kb.q: Can you take over an existing system?
kb.a: We can take over and service most existing systems. Tell us the make and model, and we will check it before we agree to take it on.

kb.q: Do you install smoke and flood sensors?
kb.a: We can connect smoke and flood sensors to your alarm if the system supports them. We confirm compatibility at the site check.
Yes, we do commercial security for shops, offices and sites. Commercial work is quoted separately after a site visit.

compliance.guidance: Security businesses and technicians need a state security licence. Keep licence numbers current on quotes and staff records. Check your state regulator (in Victoria, the Victoria Police Licensing and Regulation Division).
